Corollary
[Wedge sums and direct sum of homology] ↗ prop:good-pairs-absolute-homology 1. ch2:2.25\group Singular Homology

Suppose the wedge $\bigvee _\alpha X_\alpha $ is formed at basepoints $x_\alpha $ for which every pair $(X_\alpha ,x_\alpha )$ is good. Then the inclusions induce an isomorphism \[ \bigoplus _\alpha \widetilde H_n(X_\alpha ) \xrightarrow {\cong } \widetilde H_n\left(\bigvee _\alpha X_\alpha \right). \]

Proof

\sketch Identify reduced homology with homology relative to the wedge point and apply the good-pair quotient isomorphism before identifying the basepoints.

□
